metadata.scope: Guarded ff-only shared skill checkout sync. Plan only; no implementation, git write operations, messages or execution handoff performed.
metadata.env_convention: Shell-only knobs documented at use sites like AILANG_DRIVER_PIN and AILANG_DRIVER_DRIFT_WARN; no Go Registry changes required.
metadata.report_mode: Eligible report returns synced:N with an explicit would-sync note; target worktree, refs and index remain unchanged.
metadata.sandbox_gate_policy: Verdicts touching external paths or sockets are UNINFORMATIVE UNDER SANDBOX. Base reds are findings, not blockers to planning or permission to expand scope.
metadata.planning_validation: Base driver and pin-root bash -n returned 0. Runtime suites and live dry-run not executed.

velocity.loc_note: M1=450, M2=100; task estimate with safety/mutation review, not a measured historical velocity.

registry_reuse.reason: No package-like capability: bash/Git host worktree safety cannot be supplied by an AILANG import. Reuse tools/launchd/lib/pin-root.sh::_pin_bounded. Package registry search not applicable.
Existing driver and LAUNCHD_SUITE make harness are the integration surface; no AILANG package dependency. Package registry search not applicable.

features.description: Create sourceable bash 3.2 skill-sync helper and isolated synthetic repository safety/mutation suite.
acceptance_criteria: mc_skill_sync apply|report sets synced:N/current/skip:reason/error:token and a one-line note, always returns 0 and never exits caller.
All git calls are wall-clock bounded using the sourced _pin_bounded primitive; failure or missing primitive never falls back to direct unbounded git.
Resolve override or realpath of mission-control symlink to its git toplevel; skip absent/broken/non-worktree/self target; opt-out prevents all git calls.
Require dev branch, zero ahead, no rebase/merge/cherry-pick/revert/am/sequencer/bisect operation, no index.lock and no incoming-range/dirty-path intersection.
Parse NUL-delimited diff/status paths including rename sides, staged/unstaged/untracked paths; count unique collisions without contents; preserve dirty bytes.
Only eligible apply invokes merge --ff-only origin/dev once. Already current performs no merge. Revalidate snapshot; lock/ref refusals skip without retry or lock deletion.
Eligible report has synced:N plus would-sync note and preserves target HEAD/index/refs/worktree snapshot with GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 inspection.

Every arm builds a fresh bare origin plus dev clone plus pusher clone under mktemp, uses temporary HOME/TMPDIR, local remotes and explicit fixture identity; no real checkout, HOME skills or mission state access.
All minimum and extended arms in the plan mutation table pass; every selected single mutant turns its named arm red and restored control green; timeout mutants are independently bounded.
/bin/bash -n tools/launchd/lib/skill-sync.sh and /bin/bash -n tools/launchd/test_skill_sync.sh return 0.
/bin/bash tools/launchd/lib/suite-env.sh tools/launchd/test_skill_sync.sh returns 0.
/bin/bash tools/launchd/lib/suite-env.sh tools/launchd/test_skill_sync.sh --mutations returns 0 with non-vacuous mutation failures.

risks: Shared dirty attended checkout: exact range intersection and byte-preservation assertions required; no stash/reset/checkout/rebase.
Concurrent missions/attended edits: final preflight cannot create an atomic transaction; Git lock/refusal is last defence and no retry or lock deletion is allowed.
NUL-delimited output cannot survive command substitution: bounded git must write raw streams to scratch files for parsing.
Report status vocabulary has no would-sync family: explicit would-sync note distinguishes computed synced:N verdict from mutation.
Live skill/common-dir and 0-ahead/3-behind/dirty measurements are supplied operator premises, not freshly probed planner results.
Historical mission-loop-change skill world-fork guidance is stale against current shared-driver root code; no out-of-scope port/reload planned.
